subject: Clarifying remittance OCR fields for April invoices and VAT allocation
messages:
From: Tanya Kline <tanya.kline@zenova.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Zenova Finance <accounts@zenova.co>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 08:32:00 -0400
Subject: April remittance: OCR capture mismatch on INV-0421/0422

Hi Mina,

We processed our April sweep this morning but our AP system (OCR-based ingest) flagged an unmatched remittance for two invoice lines. The bank reference on their file reads: "ZEN-INV-0421/0422", but when our AP scanner parsed the PDF it produced "IIV-0421 IIV0422" (leading I instead of Z, and no separator). As a result, our payment engine did not auto-apply to your ledger and the invoices show as outstanding.

Quick details:
- Payment date: 2028-04-30 22:14 UTC
- File attached: remit_scan_apr04.pdf (scanned sweep + ACH advice)
- Bank amount: EUR 30,000 (gross) reported to us by bank feed

Can you confirm how Redwood expects remittance references to appear (one combined reference vs. two separate references), and whether you want us to send a corrected remittance advice to your AR team? Also, we need to be explicit about the VAT split per invoice — our VAT tagging got dropped by the OCR and we need the net/VAT breakdown to clear against the two invoice numbers.

Apologies for the extra work — we want this cleared in today’s posting run.

Thanks,
Tanya
Tanya Kline
Finance Manager
Zenova, Inc.

Attachment: remit_scan_apr04.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tanya Kline <tanya.kline@zenova.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: April remittance: OCR capture mismatch on INV-0421/0422

Hi Tanya — thanks for the note and for the remit PDF. We can get this resolved today. A few quick clarifying Qs so our AR posting matches correctly: 

1) Were INV-0421 and INV-0422 intended to be paid as a single combined payment (one gross amount) or two separate invoice-level payments?
2) Can you confirm the gross/net/VAT split per invoice. If you don't have the split, we can work from the invoice records here but prefer customer-provided allocation to avoid posting disagreements.
3) Can you attach the underlying bank export (UTC timestamped trace) if available — the scanned PDF sometimes crops the reference.

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm combined payment, we'll accept the single sweep but need the explicit net/VAT per invoice to tag on our side.
- If the bank will send a short bank trace (trace id + timestamp), we can match and auto-apply; otherwise our AR team will manual-apply and notify you of any unapplied credit.

I've exported our sample OCR parse from the attached PDF and included it here for your reference (ocr_extraction_apr04.csv). It shows two tokens parsed as "IIV-0421" and "IIV0422" which explains the mismatch.

If it's helpful I can also loop in our bank contact to request the original remittance XML.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior AR Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0183

Attachments: ocr_extraction_apr04.csv
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tanya Kline <tanya.kline@zenova.co>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: April remittance: OCR capture mismatch on INV-0421/0422 -- request for bank trace

Liam — forwarding a remit that our customer (Zenova) scanned and OCR'd incorrectly. Can Bankwise confirm the original remittance reference and provide a trace id + timestamp for the sweep on 2028-04-30? That will allow us to match and auto-apply.

Forwarded message:
> From: Tanya Kline <tanya.kline@zenova.co>
> Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 08:32:00 -0400
> Subject: April remittance: OCR capture mismatch on INV-0421/0422
> To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
> Cc: Zenova Finance <accounts@zenova.co>
>
> (See original remit PDF attached)

If you can also confirm whether the bank's export contains the pipe or slash separator (i.e. "ZEN-INV-0421|0422" or "ZEN-INV-0421/0422") that would be useful — the OCR errored on the initial character which turned a Z into an I.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@bankwise.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Tanya Kline <tanya.kline@zenova.co>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 11:15:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Fwd: April remittance: OCR capture mismatch on INV-0421/0422 -- request for bank trace

Hi all — thanks for the ping. Bankwise confirms the originating instruction for the sweep dated 2028-04-30 had the following fields in our remittance XML and inbound FIS file: 

- trace_id: BW-578392
- originating_reference: ZEN-INV-0421|0422
- payment_timestamp_utc: 2028-04-30T22:14:37Z
- gross_amount: EUR 30,000.00
- net_breakdown: INV-0421 => EUR 18,000.00 (net), VAT 20% => EUR 3,600.00; INV-0422 => EUR 6,000.00 (net), VAT 20% => EUR 1,200.00

The file attached is a short plaintext trace extract (bank_trace_578392.txt). The pipe character (|) was present in our feed; it looks like the scanned PDF produced a capital I and removed the separator.

Actionable recommendation: post as a single combined remittance but apply net/VAT per invoice as above. If Redwood needs a signed remittance advice with invoice-level allocation, we can re-issue a formatted advice upon request.

Liam Porter
Senior Remittance Ops
Bankwise Treasury Services
liam.porter@bankwise.com

Attachment: bank_trace_578392.txt
